**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 14.2).**

- **Sections 13.1–13.3 are already at the preferred position** — Affiliates and contractors named in the Services grant, a perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free licence for paid-up software and embedded Vendor Technology, transfer to an Affiliate or successor, and revocation limited to material uncured breach after notice and cure. No redline needed there.
- **Section 14.2 fails the fallback.** The Deliverable licence is "revocable, non-transferable" and lasts "only during the applicable Order Form term", with no Affiliate or contractor coverage and no successor transfer. Section 10.1 only preserves Deliverable rights "according to their terms", so those rights lapse at term end.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** conforms the Deliverable licence to Section 13 — perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid, extending to Affiliates and contractors, transferable on a Section 24 assignment, with revocation limited to Section 13.3 grounds. Vendor's ownership sentence is left intact to avoid duplicating the IP-ownership rule.
